result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontal restaurant carousel ('Fastest near you') is clipped at the right edge, cutting off the third card's name and image, and a loading spinner is overlaid on the first 'Popular right now' card image, suggesting an unfinished image load state.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge, with its name truncated and image partially off-screen. While horizontal scroll is expected, there is no visual affordance (e.g., fade, partial peek with padding) indicating more content, and the truncation looks abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a gradient fade to signal scrollability, and ensure card titles use ellipsis truncation within a defined max-width rather than being clipped by the viewport.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image in the 'Popular right now' section, indicating the image is still loading or stuck in a loading state while the rest of the page is fully rendered.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images load promptly with proper placeholders/skeletons; if this is a captured mid-load state, verify the spinner resolves and does not persist after image load completes.

issues.description: The promo banner text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is small and light on the green background, which may reduce readability.
issues.suggestion: Slightly increase font size or weight of the secondary promo line to improve legibility against the green gradient.
